=== Report === "Jees, nyt on se Villains liigan tavote taynna kun revittii voitto :) DM2 lahti kayntii tosi hyvin, ite spawnin yksin alatelelle ja ylarl ja quad mez. Kemo oli vieny alarl, joten tilanne naytti aikasta hyvalta. Alku olikin hyvin meidan hallintaa, mutta ibh sai quadin jossai vaiheessa ja paniikki oli valmis. Onneksi noustii siita ja sen jalkee _EI KAMMATTY_ ja voitettii!! Nooh kun DM2ssa ei oltu kammatty johtoasemasta kuten tapana on, niin paikattiin se hyvin sitte DM3ssa. Selkee johto kaanty taas ja viimesen pentan mentya ibh:lle oli aika alkaa valmistautuun E1M2n. E1M2 oli tosi janna era. YA oli oikeestaan koko aika ibh:lla, meilla ei oikeestaa mikaa alue koko aikaa. Asetelma oli suunnilleen etta ibh pine-ya sektorilla, me hall-ga. Sitten tapeltiin kuka saa vietya quadin. Onneksi me taidettii onnistuu paremmin ja onnistuttii voittaa era. Ibh:lla oli eraassa vaiheessa kylla tosi hyva hallinta ja ne tuli 6n fragin paahan, mutta sitte tyhjensin ya:n 2sta rl vihusta pureskillilla ja se oli siina ! :)" - Report by Lastu
Google translation:
"Jeez, now that's the goal of the Villains league when you tear up the victory :) The DM2 opening went really well, I spawned alone on the tele and upper rl and quad. Kemo- had taken lower rl, so the situation looked good for a while. The beginning was well under our control, but ibh got Quad at some point and the panic was over. Fortunately, you get up from it and your feet _NOT CUMBLE_ and you win!! Well, when in DM2 we didn't take the lead as usual, we fixed it well in DM3. A clear lead fell again and after the last penta, it was time for ibh to start preparing for E1M2. E1M2 was really Janna era. YA was actually with ibh the whole time, we don't correct any area all the time. The layout was approximately etta ibh pine-ya in the sector, me hall-ga. Then we fought over who gets to take the quad. Fortunately, we seemed to do better and managed to win the race. Ibh had a really good control at one stage and they came to 6 frags, but then I drained ya from 2 rl with pure skill and that was it! :)" - Report by Lastu == Summary == * Score: 2-1 * Total frags ** HPR: 505 ** iBh: 307 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
